definitions.explanation: A state where something necessary is lacking or insufficient.
A flaw or problem with documentation, preparation, or systems.

examples.japanese: ⟦{体制|たいせい}→体制：04490_taisei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{不備|ふび}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are deficiencies in the system.

examples.japanese: ⟦{設備|せつび}→設備：03301_setsubi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{不備|ふび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{指摘|してき}→指摘：05630_shiteki⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The inadequacies in the facilities were pointed out.

examples.japanese: {不備|ふび}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ございましたら→ございます：01300_gozaimasu⟧、ご⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please contact us if there are any deficiencies.

examples.japanese: ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{不備|ふび}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There was a problem with the documents.

examples.japanese: ⟦{契約書|けいやくしょ}→契約書：06416_keiyakusho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{不備|ふび}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: A defect in the contract was found.

examples.japanese: ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{不備|ふび}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{申請|しんせい}→申請：04207_shinsei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{却下|きゃっか}→却下：05908_kyakka⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The application was rejected because the documents were incomplete.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{不|ふ} (not) + {備|び} (preparedness) - literally "not prepared"

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{不備|ふび} - incomplete documents
- ⟦{設備|せつび}→設備：03301_setsubi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{不備|ふび} - inadequate facilities
- ⟦{体制|たいせい}→体制：04490_taisei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{不備|ふび} - systemic deficiency
- {不備|ふび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{補|おぎな}う→補う：00329_oginau⟧ - to make up for deficiencies

USAGE IN APOLOGIES:
- {不備|ふび}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ありました→ある：00006_aru⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦お{詫|わ}び→お詫び：08266_owabi⟧⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧ - We apologize for any deficiencies

- ⟦{欠陥|けっかん}→欠陥：02793_kekkan⟧ - defect, flaw
